Default decision thresholds for the adequacy call

Source: R/thresholds.R
defaultThresholds.Rd

Provisional values used by callComparisons(). The final numbers are to be derived from the validation experiments (E1-E8); until then these are sensible placeholders, documented so a user can override them.

Usage

defaultThresholds()

Value

A named list: cramerV (condition-covariate association above which a comparison is flagged Caution), vif (variance inflation factor threshold), sensitivity (expected recall at the target effect at or above which a comparison is adequately powered; 0.5 matches replication failure defined as recall below 0.5), minSamples (fewer samples per group is Invalid), cellsCondCor (absolute correlation of log cells per sample with condition above which cell-count imbalance is flagged Caution), cellsCondAlpha (the correlation must also exceed the critical value at this level for the comparison's sample size, so chance correlations in small designs are not flagged: the cutoff is max(cellsCondCor, r_crit(n)), about 0.81 at 6 samples and cellsCondCor from ~16 samples), and minTestable (fewer testable genes is Underpowered). The layer-2 values, like the others, are provisional placeholders until E1-E8.
